correctness.rationale: The simultaneous directed equitable refinement records current color, successor color, loop indicator, and predecessor-color counts; each finite-round color is definable in relational counting C². Indegree-zero pruning eliminates unions of stable classes; the surviving cycle classes have a deterministic successor permutation, and stable counts determine the full cyclic color word including its repetition number. Removing the unique cyclic predecessor and inducting up the in-arborescences reconstructs attached rooted types. Same-color cycle vertices rotate compatibly, and equal-colored subtree branches interchange recursively, giving exactly automorphism orbits. In connected one-cycle structures C²-equivalent stable histograms therefore imply isomorphism; C6 versus disjoint C3∐C3 shows connectedness essential. Independently enumerated connected labeled total maps n=2..5 and canonical orbits: 2,4,9,20 unlabeled types, no color-signature collisions.
